subject.title: fix(gateway): make busyStaleThresholdMs configurable in channel health policy

question: Should OpenClaw expose a supported gateway configuration for the busy-run stale timeout, or should channel health instead use a different non-configurable activity-aware policy?
rationale: The linked report asks for a user-facing override, while the submitted patch adds only an internal timing input; choosing the permanent public behavior and configuration surface requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt a gateway setting
options.body: Define one documented gateway setting and thread it through the canonical config contract, preserving the current 25-minute default unless an operator opts in.

options.title: Use an activity-aware policy
options.body: Keep the timeout out of user configuration and revise the health policy so legitimate ongoing activity is distinguished from a stuck run.

options.title: Keep internal-only timing injection
options.body: Accept the new dependency input solely for controlled runtime callers and clarify that it does not resolve the user-facing configuration request.

recommendation.title: Adopt a gateway setting
recommendation.body: Define one documented gateway setting and thread it through the canonical config contract, preserving the current 25-minute default unless an operator opts in.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected policy and monitor ownership must be established from current-main history before assigning the product-contract decision.
